scripts.name: Test
scripts.command: isaac_ros_common/scripts/dexec.sh -- bash -c 'colcon test --packages-skip-regex ^isaac; for p in $(colcon list --names-only --packages-skip-regex ^isaac); do colcon test-result --verbose --test-result-base build/$p; done'

scripts.name: Sim: drift
scripts.command: docker exec -it -u $(docker exec isaac_ros_jazzy_container id -un admin 2>/dev/null || echo root) -w /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev isaac_ros_jazzy_container bash -ic 'source install/setup.bash && src/sim/tools/run_suite.sh drift'

scripts.name: Sim: shot hit
scripts.command: docker exec -it -u $(docker exec isaac_ros_jazzy_container id -un admin 2>/dev/null || echo root) -w /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev isaac_ros_jazzy_container bash -ic 'source install/setup.bash && src/sim/tools/run_suite.sh shot_hit'

scripts.name: Sim: estimation
scripts.command: docker exec -it -u $(docker exec isaac_ros_jazzy_container id -un admin 2>/dev/null || echo root) -w /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev isaac_ros_jazzy_container bash -ic 'source install/setup.bash && src/sim/tools/run_suite.sh estimation'

scripts.name: Container shell
scripts.command: docker exec -it -u $(docker exec isaac_ros_jazzy_container id -un admin 2>/dev/null || echo root) -w /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev isaac_ros_jazzy_container bash -c 'exec bash --rcfile <(echo "source install/setup.bash")'

scripts.name: Submodules
scripts.command: git submodule foreach --quiet 'b=$(git config -f $toplevel/.gitmodules submodule.$name.branch); printf "%-32s %-6s on %-10s %s dirty, %s unpushed\n" $name $b "$(git branch --show-current || true)" $(git status --porcelain | wc -l) $(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ?)'
